items.title: Highlights and analysis on Match of the Day
items.description: With Man Utd v Spurs, Arsenal v Leeds and Chelsea v Bournemouth as the top flight returns

items.title: Who am I? Plus today's other quizzes
items.description: Test your ball knowledge against today's Who Am I?, Five in Five and Brainteaser.

items.title: Top five Liverpool-Man City moments
items.description: Relive five classic moments between Liverpool and Manchester City before Sunday's Premier League game at Anfield (16:30 BST).

items.title: Toxicity and uncertainty await Man City - will their season even matter?
items.description: Manchester City visit Liverpool on Sunday with a lot of uncertainty hanging over them. Phil McNulty looks at what lies ahead.

items.title: Carrick must share burden of Man Utd's failings with his players
items.description: "We couldn't find a way to get ourselves into the game. With the ball, without the ball, we were off it." A fair assessment from Michael Carrick, if not a wholly explanatory one.

items.title: 'Absolutely superb' - How Caicedo proved pivotal in Chelsea win
items.description: Speaking on Match of the Day, Alan Shearer explains why the performance of Moises Caicedo was pivotal in Chelsea's 5-1 win against Bournemouth in the Premier League.

items.title: Man Utd midfield can't control games - Murphy
items.description: Match of the Day pundit Danny Murphy looks at Manchester United's problems in midfield in their 1-1 draw against 10-man Tottenham.

items.title: AC Milan keen on Scott - Sunday's gossip
items.description: AC Milan are looking at Bournemouth's Alex Scott, Bayern Munich have held fresh talks with Manchester United's JJ Gabriel, Liverpool interested in Barcelona defender Jules Kounde, plus more.

items.title: 'I kissed Rodrigo and said thanks' - De Zerbi 'liked' Spurs red card
items.description: Roberto de Zerbi praises Rodrigo Bentancur after he was sent off in a 1-1 draw against Manchester United.

items.title: Boos, anguish & fading belief -'worrying day' for under-pressure Carrick
items.description: It couldn't happen again could it? Another failure to beat 10 men increases pressure on Man Utd boss Michael Carrick after a 1-1 draw against Tottenham Hotspur.

items.title: Patience needed as new boss Reedijk bemoans Hibs 'imprecision'
items.description: Familiar problems remain for Hibernian as Marink Reedijk's first match in charge ends in a 1-0 loss at Dundee United.
